test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Merry
solution: The correct answer is '**Happy**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the word '**Merry**' is '**Happy**'. • **Merry**: happy. (आनंदित, प्रमुदित) • *Example: **merry** laughter...* • **Happy**: feeling or showing pleasure; pleased. (आनंद का अनुभव करने या उसे व्‍यक्त करने वाला; प्रसन्‍न, प्रफुल्‍ल) • *Example: I was really **happy** to see Prakash again yesterday.* **Correct Answer:__** *Happy.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Morose**: bad-tempered, and not saying much to other people. [बदमिज़ाज, असौम्‍य (और अपने तक सीमित)] • **Somber**: dark in color; dull. (गहरे रंग का; धुँधला) • **Angry**: feeling or showing anger. (क्रोधित, ग़ुस्‍सा, नाराज़) 4b:Ta15, The correct answer is **'slightly open'.**
